seo.title: Pomo Easy — Pomodoro Timer for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: A calm Pomodoro timer that tells you where you are in plain words. Time Sensitive alerts, a Live Activity, widgets and an Apple Watch app. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: POMODORO TIMER
hero.title: Focus, then rest.
text: A calm Pomodoro timer that tells you where you are in plain words: “18 minutes of focus left”, “Break”. It keeps time on your Lock Screen, your Home Screen and your Apple Watch. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection.

items.title: The timer, in plain words
items.text: The home screen says where you are, “18 minutes of focus left” or “Break”, with one button to move forward. 25 minutes of focus, 5 of rest, and a longer break after every four.

items.title: Right every time
items.text: The countdown comes from when the session ends, so it stays right when you lock your iPhone, switch apps, restart or change the clock.

items.title: Alerts on time
items.text: Time Sensitive notifications with gentle chimes, even with the app closed. Breaks and focus sessions can start on their own, one cycle at a time.

items.title: Live Activity and widgets
items.text: See the countdown on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in small, medium and Lock Screen widgets that roll into your next break on their own.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: The timer on your wrist: the session you’re on, today’s sessions, and Start, Pause, Reset and Skip.

items.title: Tasks and history
items.text: Pick what you’re working on and count the sessions it takes. See today, your last seven days and your streak.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No accounts. Pomo Easy doesn’t make network requests. Your sessions and tasks stay on your iPhone, and your Apple Watch only shows the timer.

cta.title: Start focusing.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
